caption: The drawing depicts a folded piece of cloth, likely a handkerchief or square textile, set against a plain beige background. The cloth is predominantly red and features an elaborate floral pattern with large, multicolored flowers in yellow, green, blue, black, and pink on all visible surfaces. The design is divided by a thin yellow linear border that forms a cross, creating four distinct quadrants, each containing different floral motifs. The edges of the fabric are bordered with a repeating floral and geometric pattern in similar colors, notably with blue and red flowers and a yellow band. The textile is folded neatly, showing both its ornate inner sections and decorative edge. There is a small signature or initials, "A E," with the number "65" written in blue ink at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Economy Red Handkerchief
